candidate_relations.reason: Pleomorphic adenoma is the usual buccal salivary tumor, but incisional biopsy showed fibroblast proliferation like a fibroma, not epithelial-myoepithelial PA.
Acinic cell carcinoma is a malignant acinar neoplasm; FNA showed no malignancy and the mass is a well-bordered hypovascular buccal tumor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: acinic cell carcinoma vs bland fibroblastic mass

candidate_relations.reason: Adenoid cystic carcinoma typically infiltrates and is malignant on sampling; adjacent bone is indented, not destroyed, and FNA is negative for malignancy.
Warthin tumor is a parotid tail lesion of older smokers, not a 25-year-old woman’s 4-cm buccal-space mass.
Ultrasound describes a solid hypoechoic mass without fat signal, so this is not a lipoma.
Neurofibroma is a competing bland mesenchymal tumor of the buccal space and is a different lineage from solitary fibrous tumour.

case_quality_flags: Incisional biopsy was only 'fibroblast proliferation similar to a fibroma'; no STAT6/CD34 result confirms solitary fibrous tumour.
